bead.title: Wire the fjord Kafka change-log semantics
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The change-log path still only POSTs records to Niflheim, so there is no embedded Kafka surface that can serve stock consumers with ordered fetch and durable offsets.
ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue-server/src/change_record_sink.rs:34` through `crates/pqueue-server/src/change_record_sink.rs:266` defines only the HTTP `NiflheimChangeRecordSink`, and `crates/pqueue-server/src/lib.rs:944` through `crates/pqueue-server/src/lib.rs:979` starts only that emitter when change-record delivery is enabled.
PROPOSED FIX: implement the fjord-backed change-topic writer, single-partition per `(tenant_id, queue_id)`, with broker-assigned monotonic offsets, durable source-cursor persistence in fjord's own namespace, and the record-key / header / payload contract from ADR-014.
NON-SCOPE: tenant ACL policy, cross-tenant denial paths, and repo-wide release or packaging changes.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestKafkaChangeLogConsumesInCommandPositionOrder` proves a stock Kafka client can read one queue's change records in order.
2. `TestKafkaOffsetNeverRegressesAcrossFailover` proves failover can re-emit the same logical record without regressing the broker offset stream.
3. `go test ./... -run 'TestKafkaChangeLogConsumesInCommandPositionOrder|TestKafkaOffsetNeverRegressesAcrossFailover'`
4. `lefthook run pre-commit`
5. `lefthook run pre-push`
